1.note: Printed so; Rabbi's release of Beit She'an and Kefar Tzemaḥ is in Ḥullin 6b–7a.

2.note: Printed 'Ma'aser Ani'; no such tractate. The source is Ma'aser Sheni 5:15 (also Sotah 9:10).

3.note: Printed so; the stratagem to avoid tithes (bringing produce in by way of roofs) is in Berakhot 35b.

4.note: The verse on the reviler and blasphemer (מקול מחרף ומגדף) is Psalm 44:17 in the Hebrew numbering; kept as printed.

5.note: Printed as book 3 (ס"ג); the destruction of the Gerizim temple is in Antiquities book 13 (13.9.1). Probably for סי"ג.

6.note: Meaning of ג"א unclear; read as גירסא אחרת ('another reading') with the number 540. It may also be a date.

7.note: The rule that offerings are not accepted from a Kuti is Mishnah Sheqalim 1:5 (Weiss himself cites 1:5 in note 2). Kept as printed.

8.note: Simeon's appointment is in Antiquities book 13 (13.6.7); book 12 looks wrong. Kept as printed.

9.note: idiom, literally 'saw the letters backward'; rendered as foreseeing the outcome
